target.title: fix(gateway): count pending restarts toward maxRestartsPerHour budget
target.body:
### What Problem This Solves

When a channel is permanently stuck in a pending restart state, the health monitor bypasses the maxRestartsPerHour limit, causing infinite restart attempts that thrash the channel manager.

### Why This Change Was Made

The `continuingPendingRestart` guard on lines 186 and 197-200 of `channel-health-monitor.ts` prevented both the rate-limit check and the restart record update for pending restarts. Once a channel entered a permanently-pending state, every monitor tick would attempt another restart without counting it against the hourly budget.

### What Changed

- Removed `!continuingPendingRestart &&` from `maxRestartsPerHour` check — pending restarts are now subject to the same hourly rate limit as fresh restarts
- Removed the `!continuingPendingRestart` guard from the record-update block — pending restarts are now recorded in `restartsThisHour`
- The cooldown check (fresh-restart throttle between different channels) still correctly skips for pending restarts, since they are continuing an already-begun recovery

### Evidence

#### Regression Test

`src/gateway/channel-health-monitor.test.ts:523` — Simulates a channel where every restart transitions to pending (`running=false, restartPending=true`), configures `maxRestartsPerHour=2`, runs 30 seconds of health checks, and asserts `startChannel` is called at most 2 times.

#### Test Output

```
 ✓ caps pending recovery restarts at the configured maxRestartsPerHour

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  135 passed (135)
```

#### Live Verification

Verified in-process via static source analysis on the fix branch:

```
VERIFY #105189: health-monitor pending recovery restart cap
  maxRestartsPerHour checks: 1
    if (record.restartsThisHour.length >= maxRestartsPerHour) {    ← no continuingPendingRestart bypass
  record update skips for pending: ✅ NO                          ← record always updates
PR #105415 (health-monitor): ✅ VERIFIED
```

The fix branch confirms:
1. `maxRestartsPerHour` check reads `if (record.restartsThisHour.length >= maxRestartsPerHour)` — no `continuingPendingRestart` guard
2. Record update always sets `lastRestartAt` and pushes to `restartsThisHour` — no `if (!continuingPendingRestart)` guard
3. The cooldown check still correctly skips for pending restarts via `if (!continuingPendingRestart && now - record.lastRestartAt <= cooldownMs)`

Fixes #105189
